scientific_question: Does frozen PAFA 5-second window/token-level pooling recover dataset-native task performance that recording/event-level mean pooling may hide?
claim_boundary: target-supervised frozen-feature diagnostic with ICBHI official-test-selected PAFA task encoder; no causal shortcut, clean source-generalization, full-encoder, or universal-improvement claim

frozen_dependencies.pafa_task_checkpoint_caveat: ICBHI official-test-selected epoch 27; target-supervised source checkpoint
frozen_dependencies.d2_schedule: dataset-balanced five KAUH-fold-conditioned joint native-head schedule

unit_to_window_lineage.icbhi: cycle crop in memory, mono 16 kHz, author PAFA 5 s repeat/truncate+fade, normally one window
unit_to_window_lineage.sprsound: event crop in memory, label-free inter manifest, mono 16 kHz, author PAFA 5 s repeat/truncate+fade, normally one window
unit_to_window_lineage.hf_lung: full 15 s recording represented by exactly three non-overlapping 5 s PAFA windows; no center-crop; mean-pooled only in P0/P2
unit_to_window_lineage.kauh: full recording represented by contiguous non-overlapping 5 s PAFA windows plus one end-aligned tail when needed; no patient leakage across fixed OOF folds

p0_r0_d2_pooled_reference.source: read-only corrected Gate B R0+D2 pooled reference
p0_r0_d2_pooled_reference.purpose: accepted pooled baseline reference; not retrained

p1_event_sensitive_learned_pooling.source: new 5-second window embedding cache from the same frozen PAFA encoder
p1_event_sensitive_learned_pooling.pooling: masked softmax attention over windows using LayerNorm(768)+Linear(768,1)
p1_event_sensitive_learned_pooling.head: D2 SharedNativeModel native heads
p1_event_sensitive_learned_pooling.trainable_scope: pooling scorer plus shared adapter plus native heads

p2_parameter_matched_pooled_control.source: same new 5-second window cache, mean-pooled before model
p2_parameter_matched_pooled_control.pooling: pooled-feature scalar gate using LayerNorm(768)+Linear(768,1), no window structure
p2_parameter_matched_pooled_control.head: D2 SharedNativeModel native heads
p2_parameter_matched_pooled_control.parameter_matching: same scorer/gate parameter count as P1

training.encoder: frozen PAFA BEATs encoder only; source classifier/projector discarded for downstream prediction
training.selection: validation mean macro-F1 across six native tasks only; outer/test and SPR inter labels never select checkpoint
training.loss: unweighted CE/BCE per native task, missing labels omitted and never treated as negative

decision_rule.primary_comparison: P1 minus P2 by task; P0 is the accepted pooled reference anchor
decision_rule.task_vote: P1-P2 macro_f1_mean >= 0.03 and either UAR/native_score improves or is not worse than -0.03; weighted_or_micro_f1 and specificity/native guardrails must not regress by more than 0.03 where defined
decision_rule.success: at least two primary-evaluable native tasks vote positive
decision_rule.sparse_label_policy: diagnostic and not-evaluable labels cannot provide success votes; support=1 Both remains descriptive only
decision_rule.if_negative: recommend window/token-level event-sensitive pooling not supported here; do not automatically implement another method

required: window cache ordered IDs and finite masks
encoder frozen and source heads absent
SPRSound label-free prediction before terminal join
no dataset ID or device metadata as model input
